create.title: Canonical hard actual-symbol Fejer-Gram estimate on the first residual M1 band
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt(X), Q=J^(2/5), T=J^(3/5), J^(13/18)<C<=J^(3/4), B=C/T, D_1=floor(J^(87/140)), and E_*=floor(Q^2J^(-1/20))=floor(J^(3/4)). Fix one accepted transition-flattened smooth nonaxial principal component, one class (g_kappa,M,K) in {(1,4b,k),(2,2b,2[k bar4]_b),(4,b,[k bar4]_b)}, one sign, alias, and reflected orientation. With the exact Round-81 Fourier symbol I_b, normalized physical rows R_(b,x), ordered-pair functions F_(b,P), and accepted dyadic multiplier Pi_(b,U) supported in D_1<|d|<Delta_b-E_*, form H_(b,U) and E_U=sum_(b asymp B)int_T |D_U(theta)|^2|H_(b,U)(theta)|^2 dtheta. Expand on u!=0 and remove successively the Round-87 same-group owner, Round-88 coarse shells R_*<=rho_*, Round-88 good-prime graph mathfrak a>=M^2/rho_*^2, and Round-89 certified bad-prime cells and summable unions, where rho_*=min(M,floor(J^(11/30)B^(-2))). The literal conjugation-closed complement retains all classes and signs, modulus multiples, centered Ramanujan terms, the full 2-part, nonunit-K, affine/full-phase and projection-only periods, shallow and aperiodic factors, and the complete fourfold actual symbol. Prove uniformly in every accepted U that |E_hard(U)|<<_epsilon X^epsilon(U/B)J^(14/5). Together with the one global u=0 owner, the accepted prior owners, and |sum_(b asymp B)H_(b,U)(0)|^2<<_epsilon X^epsilon(B/U)E_U, this closes only the first-band smooth nonaxial principal packet at linear target J^(7/5). The top linear and Gram capacity gaps are respectively J^(1/12) and J^(1/6), one deficit at two norm levels.
create.next_action: Seek joint signed cancellation in the complete actual four-row operator strong enough to gain J^(-1/6) at Gram level, equivalently J^(-1/12) after Toeplitz. Do not resume coefficient-blind period peeling.

create.title: Canonical joint density-discrepancy energy for the residual hard top M2 cone
create.statement_tex: Let H_L be the exact finite odd top-frequency support, T_end,L=sum_m R_m the accepted transposed-row regrouping, and E_L^top=sum_m|R_m|^2, so |T_end,L|^2<<L E_L^top. After the unique Round-75 diagonal, Round-77 endpoint/collar and original Poisson-mode owners, Round-78 square-ray owner, Round-79 exact nonsquare-centre and positive-safe owners, and bounded boundary/profile terms, write every residual primitive odd ray h=ga,s=gb with u_ang=(sqrt(b)-sqrt(a))/(sqrt(b)+sqrt(a)), Lambda=X(sqrt(b)-sqrt(a))^2/2, and Ju_ang/(1-u_ang)<k<2Ju_ang/(1+u_ang). On dyadic blocks a asymp A, b-a asymp D_ray, k asymp K_rec, |G_(a,b)| asymp G, and rho=AJD_ray^3/L^3>>1, retain the complete actual collar-extracted coefficient and the punctured metric partition W_R=mu_R+sum_(r!=0)W_hat_R(r)e(r·). Let Q_(A,D_ray,K_rec,G,R) be the resulting complete chi_4(ga)chi_4(gb) block with the metric density r=0 and every discrepancy mode r!=0 coupled, both conjugate orientations, and one outer 2Re. Prove sum_(A,D_ray,K_rec,G,R)|Q_(A,D_ray,K_rec,G,R)|<<_epsilon L^2X^epsilon. The exact one-count energy identity then gives E_L^top<<_epsilon L^2X^epsilon and T_end,L<<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon. The positive hard-block capacity is L^2X^epsilon sqrt(rho), so the required relative gain is rho^(-1/2). This closes only the residual hard top cone, not the other M2 packets or all-denominator endpoint assembly.
create.next_action: Prove a joint signed moment or exceptional-set estimate gaining rho^(-1/2) for the complete actual density-discrepancy block. Do not delete the density mode, extract quotient parity, or repeat reciprocal Poisson.

create.title: Xiao square-root moment theorem hypothesis audit
create.statement_tex: Audit the exact hypotheses and possible maps of Xiao's second moment, fourth moment, and discrepancy theorems before any use. The source studies the unweighted S(h,n)=sum_(n/2<=a<=n)e(h sqrt(a)); its averaged height norms and separate pointwise input do not presently map to either fixed-X canonical actual-symbol core.
create.next_action: Keep Xiao as a guardrail unless a future argument supplies a literal variable, coefficient, support, norm, and endpoint map plus a pointwise consequence.

reject.reason: Round 92 supplies exact definitions, owners, capacities, and bridges only. Neither signed hard estimate is derived.
The exact full-degree Gram capacity retains the J^(1/6) gap and Toeplitz returns it to the J^(1/12) linear gap; the q=8 control forbids a coefficient-blind period-depth conclusion.
The complete coefficient carrier restores integer metric frequencies and the literal density zero mode; density and discrepancy must be estimated jointly.
The top cone is only one M2 packet, and endpoint uniformity requires all active denominator scales and both M1/M2 assemblies.
